svg.title: What this project does not claim
svg.desc: Eight limits: no novelty on the kernels, no cross-hardware guarantee, no throughput superiority, one model only, no copy-on-write, ten mutation operators rather than fifty, coverage against a derived model, and execution counters proving only that the path ran.
